reviews.title: Lost all my journal activity
reviews.text: I’ve been using and paying since 2022. Just opened the app for the first time in a few months and everything is gone. Great. The catharsis of writing about my dog passing away is lost. Thanks Molskine, I won’t be renewing

reviews.title: Pls make entry list view
reviews.text: I like the app my only thing is like others have mentioned, you can’t easily see a list of previous entries anywhere, and an indicator on the month view would really help too. This should be a basic feature and this is why other apps are better. I love the simplicity and modern feel of other Moleskine apps like Timepage and Actions which I pay for and use, but this one lacks that simplicity and therefore modern feel also. Please give us some more features. I feel like this all-in-one feel is great and there aren’t many apps like this one, but the old version i have to say I loved more because past entries were easily accessible in a timeline on each journal/note/ etc. Give us something like this! Would love an upgrade to a more modern feel as well because this app can be so much more beautiful like other Moleskine apps and useful. Agree that the old version was better, it was my go-to app and this is sorry to say, like a down grade in ways. Give us something better than the previous and current version and I’ll keep paying and appreciating.

reviews.title: Someone ruined the app
reviews.text: This used to be my go to app for taking notes.  Now it’s incredibly difficult to use.  I spent so much time learning how to used the previous version.  Poor decision.

reviews.title: Great and helpful
reviews.text: I have found this app so helpful, I can sync it across my phone and MacBook!

reviews.title: Very poor re-design strategy
reviews.text:
I was really happy with the app until the recent changes. Change itself isn’t bad, but the way this was handled felt like a letdown… no announcement, no notifications and no option to return to the previous version. As a paying user, this came across as very disappointing and even disrespectful.

All my lists are now gone and I can’t find a way to recover them. From what I see here, I’m not alone as many other users are having the same issue. The fact that nothing has been done to help us speaks volumes about the management.

It’s sad to say, but I think it’s time for us to move on and look for a brand that actually values and supports its customers.

reviews.title: Theft
reviews.text: Seriously? I’ve been a premium user of Moleskine Journey for several years. Tonight I found it replaced by an entirely different app. Not even an updated planner app. A journal app. I want my money back.

reviews.title: Ruined a great app, bring back Journey!
reviews.text: They took a great app, journey, and completely ruined it by turning it into another run of the mill journaling app. The beauty of journey was that it combined journals, lists, todos in a way that you could manage to mirror your life. Not any more. No way to export my old data except to a worthless pdf. And then the gall to send me a welcome email asking for feedback and comments from a “no reply” address. Clueless developers. They keep telling us that they’re “aware of our concerns” but they obviously don’t because if they did they’d bring back journeys.  Never got a refund for buying a year if an app that was immediately switched for a piece of junk.

reviews.title: This app is garbage
reviews.text: This app is garbage compared to Journey. Why Moleskin wanted to stab its subscribers in the back is a true mystery. What a way to destroy any goodwill for your brand.

reviews.title: Journey was really special and now it’s gone
reviews.text: After the breakup with Bonobo, this app transformed from Journey to Journal. It’s so dissimilar that I would consider this an entirely different app with some overlapping features. Journey offered significantly more customization with an elegant UI. Journal and Planner are still elegant, but I think they’re overloaded with graphics, a bit clunky, and the font is enormous. So much wasted space. I really loved Journey. I used it every day for years. Journal is just not even close.

reviews.title: BRING BACK JOURNEY
reviews.text: Journey was the perfect note taking app, easy to navigate, straight forward, no frills. that’s what i wanted, that’s what i paid for. Now that i updated it it’s just a journal app that won’t let me access my old account or notes! Currently shopping for other note taking/ task planner apps.

reviews.title: New improvements are great
reviews.text: I’ve tried this app before, but it was pretty bare bones.  Recently, they must have updated it and I’m loving the improvements.  One thing I would like to see them add is more stickers or the ability to upload stickers.  It’s on the right track and I’m hopeful that they’ll keep updating and improving it.  I have been waffling between the new Apple Journal app, Day One, and this app.  So far, I really like Moleskine presents the day.  It’s the most visually appealing for me.  Keep adding new things, Moleskine!

reviews.title: Replaced functional daily planner with basic journal that was not what I paid for.
reviews.text: One day the Journey app, which was very pretty and intuitive and had projects, todos and journal was replaced by the Moleskine Journal app, which is basic, less intuitive and less aesthetically pleasing than Journey. It has a prettier logo, but that’s about the only improvement I can see. I assume that they did this so people would have to subscribe to their useless suite of productivity apps instead of having an integrated app that was less expensive. I paid for a specific product and got something else.

reviews.title: New update from Journey to Journal - what happened?
reviews.text: Journey was beautiful and a pleasure to use - every time I opened it, I was reminded of the quality and style of the Moleskine brand. Journal is not attractive at all and using is it clunky. It feels unfinished, it is difficult to understand how to use, and I don’t understand why the decision was made to turn the beautiful Journey app into this awful mess (sorry).

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: This was the best app until then changed it from Journey

reviews.title: Missing BIG feature
reviews.text:
I’ve been waiting for a solid journal app from Moleskin and for the most part it doesn’t disappoint. It keeps it simple and doesn’t over due it with adding too many cluttered features in one app. All formatted well and is smooth like you would expect.
BIG issue is I can’t find my past journal entries without digging through the calendar day by day. 
I don’t journal entry every day, so If I want to find out when my last entry was their is NO indicator on the calendar to find an entry. There is NO section of the app where it has all journal entries back to back where you can scroll through entries you’ve made over a period of time with gaps. There is NO search function I could find to look up an entry, which is a missed opportunity to add. Only thing I can find is the AMOUNT of entries I’ve done but I can’t like select it and see them back to back. You literally have to go into calendar and keep swiping right until you find the most recent entry, swiping back each week or guess the week on the calendar. 
Again it’s a bigger issue for me since I do not entry regularly, I do it periodically. So I’ve noticed every time I return to the app It takes to long to find my previous entries to see where I was a couple weeks ago, months ago, etc. Daily users probably won’t have the same problem, but adding a search function or a quick scroll page to go through all entries with the date and key words/sticker from the entry would be big.

reviews.title: Used to be original and customizable
reviews.text: I’m really disappointed in the changes to this app. It used to be super customizable and personal where you could create your own routines with questions, check lists, metrics, multiple choice, etc. All customizable options have been taken away and it’s just a glorified calendar now. I used to use this to help me plan out and set intention for each day but now it’s of no use to me.

reviews.title: Personal Journal With No Encryption?
reviews.text: Having a journal app with no option to encrypt (preferably end-to-end) is just a notes app in my opinion. I definitely wouldn’t feel safe really opening up and putting anything personal into a journaling app that others could possible read. That’s why end-to end encryption should be the minimum for a journal app because you have to have blind trust that no one is accessing your most personal details.

reviews.title: May 2025 Update is Devastating
reviews.text: I’m am absolutely devastated. I journaled and habit tracked in Journey for 4 years straight. The update is a completely new app, blowing away all my data from the last 4 years. I can export my old data to a PDF but since it’s 4 years of DAILY entries it’s not working to export. I am actually crying I can’t believe it’s gone. You cannot set up the app even remotely close to how it was and now it has a bunch of useless stuff and became just like any other app on the App Store. Once I get my data, if I can, I’m canceling. I’m completely devastated. Journey WAS the best app for reflection and personal growth on the market and now it’s gone. I’m beyond heart broken. If anyone from support can help me get my old data please, I’m begging you. I can’t find a support email anywhere.

reviews.title: Bamboozled
reviews.text:
Recently purchased Journey app to coexist with the Planner app.
This new Moleskine Journal app is not what I paid for nor what I wanted. The export feature from my Journey account doesn’t work. Allows me to print, not export. So, now I don’t have access to any of my custom journals or tasks. Setttings do show that I have several journals, no mention of projects and of course no way of contacting corporate other than a one way email. So I am now paying for a year’s subscription for an app I will mostly never use. The journaling was really an extra for me. It was more about organizing activities, projects and routines. Maybe, working into journaling so, again not what I ordered and not what I paid for

Then they changed the entire functionality of the app by changing to from Journey to Journal and it’s useless to me. There are so many other journaling apps out there and this one stood out. I got a refund because I was no longer getting what I paid for.

reviews.title: Latest update completely changed this app - for the worse.
reviews.text: I started using this app years ago when it was Journey.  Over the last several years, I’ve seen its functionality get nerfed and this finally killed it for me.  Imagine my frustration trying to open the app I had all my work projects in (during a meeting) only to discover that the latest update had changed it to a completely different app which no longer supported the “Projects” feature.  I had to install a completely separate app (Moleskine Planner) to be able to access my data.  This isn’t even kind of the same app I downloaded and have been using for the last five years.  If you want to make a new app, then make a new app.  Don’t strip away all the functionality your customers were PAYING FOR and call it an update.  Guess I’m switching to Milanote.

reviews.title: New Update Ruined It

reviews.text:
I have been a subscriber to the moleskin app family for YEARS since it was Moleskin Timepage (and free). It used to be a few different apps with different purposes, then they moved it all to one app. I still used it for all my daily reminders/ tasks. 
NOW!? ITS LITERALLY JUST A GLORIFFIED NOTES APP LIKE APPLE RELEASED THIS ALREADY AND NO ONE USED IT. I had important stuff written in the “Projects” tab of the app and its all GONE. WITHOUT NOTICE. RIDICULOUS.

reviews.title: Time, energy & effort gone?
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over a year & spent so much time curating it & personalizing it (as the app encouraged) only for all my information & data to disappear overnight & be replaced with a clunkier version of this app. It would be one thing to change the format but to clear my history & all the hours & intention I put into it is not only upsetting but disappointing. This new version feels like a regressed prototype of what the app was intended to be. What’s the point in “tracking progress” on this app if you’re just going to wipe it out anytime you feel like it. I have so much information, progress & data on the previous version that I hope can be salvaged & if not I honestly don’t know what I’ll do. I’m praying they fix this but if you still see this review up I’m afraid it’s not worth the money nor the headache. Save yourself for an app that at least offers consistency & security for the data you input.

reviews.title: Inferior and wholly different than Journey
reviews.text:
This isn’t a “reimagined” Journey app. This is a plain journal app stripped of all the wonderful features of Journey. I used Journey daily to plan out and keep track of my entire life and plan for the future. With zero warning Journey disappears. All my notes across all notebooks GONE. I used these notebooks exclusively to take stock of my yearly accomplishments. Now halfway thru the year I have nothing to reference. 
I’m truly astounded at this move. This isn’t an app update. This is a foundational shift that destroyed my information and my trust and respect for this company. 
Shame on you Moleskine for this.

reviews.title: From Useful to Frustrating — A Major Step Back
reviews.text:
I'm really not sure what the purpose of this new update was. It doesn’t feel like an upgrade—it feels like a completely different app. This goes way beyond a UI redesign: core functionality has been removed, new features have been added that don’t add value, and the overall experience has changed dramatically. If the changes were going to be this extreme, it honestly would’ve made more sense to launch a separate app instead of replacing the one users were already invested in.

The old app kept everything well-organized and functional. It was clean, reliable, and easy to use for journaling, calendar tracking, habit monitoring, and capturing random thoughts. Now, it's all over the place. The new layout is chaotic, disorganized, and cluttered with things like unnecessary “daily picture covers” that just take up space without contributing anything useful.

Worse still, many essential features are gone. There's no way to sync old data, so everything I wrote and tracked before is now lost. Habit tracking is missing, and my journal history is nowhere to be found. I paid for a subscription with the expectation that I was investing in a long-term, stable tool—what I got instead is a flashy redesign that abandoned the core reasons I used the app in the first place.

On top of that, the app forces you into dark mode with no option to change themes. There's zero customization, which is especially frustrating considering how polished and user-friendly the old version was.

Overall, the app now feels more like a design experiment than a functional productivity tool. It's focused on trends and aesthetics instead of reliability and substance. Longtime users deserve better than this.

reviews.title: Terrible update
reviews.text: This latest update completely ruined the app. I’ve been using Journey for YEARS, and woke up to a completely different app this morning. All my habits, journals, and projects just gone overnight. So disappointing, especially after paying $30+ a year. I will be cancelling my subscription immediately.

reviews.title: Stay Away!
reviews.text: Downloaded the app, within the app they offered a 7 day free trial period. I accepted and was immediately charged for the annual bundle. I’ve messaged support about this multiple times and no response. The apps aren’t even that polished and need a lot more work then just a rename from Journey to Journal. If you don’t want to be robbed, I suggest you stay away from these developers.

reviews.title: I too desperately want Journey back
reviews.text: I’ve been using journey for years. I’m logged in on the correct account, all of my journals are gone along with all of my notes and data. Even if they weren’t all gone now there’s no way to search keywords to quickly find the exact note I’m looking for. I miss my custom theme, I don’t like the new background. I’m overall incredibly disappointed.

reviews.title: Did not want a Journal!!!
reviews.text: Update and completely removed the app and my data. Was using as Journey Planner app, changed to Journal and info is only available as pdf. Wrecked my planning completely. I can only go in and download my notes and lists and other information as a pdf. Under each day. Individually. This was unannounced and unfair. Paid premium renewal and have lost volumes of information, I’m out the $30 annual renewal fee and now hours to try to download and fill in information to another account that I will no doubt need to pay for, I’m furious. Zero response from customer support. I expected better from this company.

reviews.title: App Update
reviews.text: So disappointed to find out the app has entirely changed without any notice. How can you take a multi-functional app and turn it into basically just journaling? Many users could just use Notes or the Journal app Apple has added. I have paid for the year subscription for an app I no longer have an interest in using. What a waste.

reviews.title: I Want Journey Back!!
reviews.text:
I've been using the Moleskine apps for YEARS. This one is now unusable to me.
I can't add color coded tasks, my macbook app wont even sync my calendar events. I don't like how the app is dark. This is wayyy too different. It didn't even keep the essence of Journey.

reviews.title: Horrible upgrade
reviews.text: I had all of my data organized just the way I wanted it and with the new update it’s not even automatically imported. There’s no way to set it up the way I had it. All I can do is export as PDF, which is useless to me. You are losing my subscription. This is not the app I signed up for.

reviews.title: Not what I signed up for
reviews.text: I am so disappointed. I’ve been using Journey for a couple of weeks now and was really enjoying it. I was specifically looking for an app that would have all my tasks and calendar in one view and also habit track them. This is exactly what I was getting. Then this morning I log in and they’ve COMPLETELY changed the app. It’s nothing like what I had. They wiped out all my data and it no longer does what I signed up for it to do. I hope they don’t do this to people again, but they’ve lost my business.

reviews.title: Update ruined app
reviews.text:
The latest update completely changed the flow of the app. It is not nearly as customizable & it doesn’t allow for multiple journals as it did previously. 
What happened to the Project section??? I was willing to pay for a highly functional app, but is ridiculous to pay for something that might as well just be using Notes or Pages. WHY WHY WHY did you take away so many awesome features and turn this into a very basic journaling app. Maybe you thought users were gonna stick around because they purchased your suite of apps with the calendar and to-do actions list. You’re going to lose this user because you’re making me pay for something you no longer provide. WHY WHY WHY did you ruin this app?
